steps: Chemistry has a very wide scope and includes a large number of substances, facts and reactions.
It is difficult to study all the knowledge of Chemistry as one subject; therefore, it is divided into branches for systematic study.
The branches allow people to specialise in particular areas and make the study of Chemistry easier and more useful.
items.finalAnswer: Chemistry is divided into branches because its scope is very wide, its knowledge is difficult to study as one subject, and specialisation makes its study systematic and useful.

steps: Reactions involving electrons outside the nucleus are studied in Physical Chemistry.
Reactions that take place inside the nucleus are studied in Nuclear Chemistry.
items.finalAnswer: Physical Chemistry studies reactions involving electrons outside the nucleus, while Nuclear Chemistry studies reactions inside the nucleus.

steps: Graphene is a one-atom-thick layer of carbon atoms arranged in a sheet.
It is very strong, light, flexible and transparent, and it conducts electricity very well.
Because of these properties, graphene is useful in electronic devices, touch screens, solar cells and batteries.
items.finalAnswer: Graphene’s strength, lightness, flexibility, transparency and electrical conductivity make it useful in electronic devices, touch screens, solar cells and batteries.

steps: The existence of an element in two or more different forms in the same physical state is called allotropy. These different forms are called allotropes.
Carbon has crystalline and non-crystalline (amorphous) allotropes.

The crystalline forms of carbon include diamond, graphite and fullerenes. In diamond, each carbon atom is strongly bonded to four other carbon atoms, making it very hard. In graphite, each carbon atom is bonded to three others in layers; the layers can slide over one another, so graphite is soft and slippery. Fullerenes consist of carbon atoms arranged in hollow cage-like structures.
Amorphous forms of carbon include coal, coke, charcoal and lampblack. They do not have a regular crystalline structure.

Sulphur has two important crystalline allotropes: rhombic sulphur and monoclinic sulphur. Rhombic sulphur consists of yellow octahedral crystals and is stable below 96°C. Monoclinic sulphur consists of yellow needle-shaped crystals and is stable above 96°C. On cooling below 96°C, monoclinic sulphur changes into rhombic sulphur.
Coal is an impure, amorphous form of carbon, whereas diamond is a crystalline form of carbon. Coal is black and comparatively soft; diamond is a pure, transparent crystal and is extremely hard.
items.finalAnswer: Allotropy is the existence of an element in different forms in the same physical state. Carbon has crystalline and amorphous forms, while sulphur has rhombic and monoclinic forms. Coal is impure amorphous carbon; diamond is pure crystalline carbon and is extremely hard.
